items.title: Absorb, Accelerate, Act as a Risk Sponge
items.summary: Good leaders absorb risk to optimize learning rate, unblock teams, and break through indecision. A well-functioning team applies this fractally.
items.author: Ilya Grigorik

items.title: Guide to effective meetings
items.summary: Separate social, info-sharing, and decision-making meetings. Effective meetings require a process owner, agenda, preread, and curated attendees.
items.author: Ilya Grigorik

items.title: Good decision-making is good process
items.summary: Define the problem in own terms, take perspectives, validate signal, decide when to decide, and execute.
items.author: Ilya Grigorik

items.title: The Principal Engineer's Handbook
items.summary: Leadership without management: the what, the how, the tools,  and how to measure success as a Principal+ engineer.
items.author: Ilya Grigorik

items.title: Professional Aptitude vs. Tenure
items.summary: Aptitude is the ability to perform a type of work. Tenure is the length of time in job. Their correlation degrades rapidly.
items.author: Ilya Grigorik

items.title: Making Good Group Decisions, Effectively
items.summary: Good decision-making is good process, used intentionally. Key lessons and principles to apply in your practice.
